privacy: Synthetic, repository-owned public examples only. No user or personal data.

sources.title: Fictional public research archive
sources.text: The demo archive stores public research notes. Each note keeps its source reference and selected evidence. Readers choose keyword hints before selecting evidence sentences. A build-time language model summarizes only the selected evidence.

sources.title: Fictional seedling light trial
sources.text: The trial compares seedlings under two light schedules. Each tray receives the same amount of water. Observers record leaf counts every three days. Seedlings under longer light develop more leaves in this fictional trial. The trial does not measure fruit yield.

sources.title: Fictional gear housing workshop
sources.text: A fictional workshop tests three reusable gear housings. Printed housings are weighed before the load test. The load test applies the same force to every housing. A cracked housing is removed from later vibration tests. The workshop records material use separately from durability.

choices.label: Cracked housing exclusion from vibration tests
Housing comparison and separate material accounting

sources.title: Synthetic audio duration study
sources.text: The synthetic audio experiment compares a flute tone and a drum beat. The flute tone sustains for four seconds. The drum beat decays within one second. Listeners compare the rhythm while playback volume stays fixed. The experiment records duration and rhythm as separate measurements.
